method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: A user may be barred from a Reward at the sole discretion of Day Traders for disregard for these Terms or any other disruptive manner; for Prohibited Conduct Day Traders may determine at its own discretion the nature of the behaviour and reasonable consequences.
Disparaging Day Traders (or its competitors) is a ground to bar a user from a Reward.
Funding with Day Traders capital or another product after the evaluation shall be governed pursuant to separate or supplemental written agreement, not published with the terms.
